prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Screen Shift After Adoption: Reorder the onboarding flow so sign-in takes place right after the adoption certificate stage, linking the pet to the account immediately. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, and adoption has the lowest stage conversion (67.9%).)
1: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Pet Creation Workspace: Redesign the photo upload screen into a two-column split layout with visual photo quality previews and side-by-side tips. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 67.9% and support reported 3 cases of custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Loss Prevention Hint: Add an explicit safety hint beneath the sign-in options explaining how existing pet profiles stay saved to your account. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing back into an account.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Two Column Path Options View: Update choose_path layout to two_column with side-by-side choice cards highlighting quick selection versus custom pet creation. (why: Choose path stage has a high mean time of 514s, showing friction and hesitation when picking an onboarding path.)
4: [home, wait_info] Live Spawntime Tip Carousel: Display an auto-rotating tip carousel on the waiting screen featuring helpful commands and pet care hints while pet assets render. (why: Home wait stage has a median duration of 201s with potential user drop-off during long renders.)
5: [adoption, copy] Photo Validation Clear Requirements Copy: Rewrite headline and hint text on the photo upload screen to specify high contrast, front-facing single pet photo guidelines. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted custom pet generation errors or distorted pet appearances.)
6: [finish, incentive] First Interaction Mascot Welcome Incentive: Add an animated mascot and action badge on the finish screen inviting the user to click and awaken their pet on desktop. (why: The final stage drops to 64.8% completion with high average duration, showing users get stuck before completing setup.)
